title: Commit19ffdf4introducing a bug inunpin_memorycall
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

The commit https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/commit/19ffdf4ea053bc5befe7eaa737fd1fafaaeb34a2 introduced in bug with this line:
```python
weakref.finalize(t, pin_memory_utils.unpin_memory, t)
```
i.e. calling `pin_memory_utils.unpin_memory` with a tensor instead of the `data_ptr`, leading to a failure the underlying unpin CUDA method:

```bash
[rank0]:[rank0]:     succ = int(torch.cuda.cudart().cudaHostUnregister(data_ptr))
[rank0]:[rank0]: TypeError: cudaHostUnregister(): incompatible function arguments. The following argument types are supported:
[rank0]:[rank0]:     1. (arg0: int) -> torch._C._cudart.cudaError
```

### Versions

Torch 2.8
